description: This file contains the definition of the Redis cache class used within the OpenCart system. It provides methods to get, set, and delete cache entries in a Redis store for the opencart application.

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: Class that provides Redis-based caching functionalities, including retrieval, storage, and deletion of cache data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection with an optional expiration time for cache entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value for a given key, decoding the JSON data stored in Redis.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in Redis cache under the specified key, encoding it as JSON, and setting its expiration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cached entry by key from Redis.
